diff.content:
diff --git a/storectl/guidance.py b/storectl/guidance.py
--- a/storectl/guidance.py
+++ b/storectl/guidance.py
@@ -14,1 +14,10 @@ def render_apply_plan(plan):
     return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def render_rollback_guidance(store_root):
+    """Return the operator commands that undo an applied migration."""
+    return [
+        f"storectl export --all > {store_root}.backup.json",
+        f"storectl import {store_root}.backup.json",
+        f"rm -f {store_root}.backup.json",
+    ]
diff --git a/tests/test_guidance.py b/tests/test_guidance.py
--- a/tests/test_guidance.py
+++ b/tests/test_guidance.py
@@ -31,1 +31,7 @@ def test_render_apply_plan_lists_every_step():
     assert len(render_apply_plan(plan)) > 0
+
+
+def test_render_rollback_guidance_emits_three_steps():
+    commands = render_rollback_guidance("/srv/store")
+    assert len(commands) == 3
+    assert all(command.strip() for command in commands)

change_contract.goal: Give operators a copy-pasteable rollback procedure after an applied migration.
acceptance_criteria: The rendered guidance is a runnable sequence of `storectl` commands.
Every emitted command exists in the installed `storectl` interface.
The guidance names the store root the operator actually migrated.
non_goals: Change how the apply plan itself is rendered.

repository_instructions.label: Operator guidance rules
repository_instructions.summary: Emitted operator commands must be runnable against the installed CLI; never document a subcommand the tool does not expose.

nearby_patterns.label: Command surface the CLI actually registers

data: The store root is an operator-supplied filesystem path.
operational: Operators copy this guidance directly into a shell during an incident.
